passive.fixercity.irina.desc: Taking 3 hits without hitting back resets your weapon skill. Every 10s removes Weakness, Slowness and Mining Fatigue. Below 30% health: Absorption II and Regeneration (once per minute). Speed III
kit.fixercity.irina.desc: Fixer Longsword, Armored coat, Irina key page
passive.fixercity.yae: Puffy Brume · Excess Supply · Immediate Repairs · Madness
passive.fixercity.yae.desc: Hits add smoke (max 10; +3% damage each, Strength at 8+, +2 damage at 10). Recover from stagger instantly once per life. Every 15s a random Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II or Fragile. Speed III
kit.fixercity.yae.desc: Smoke Gear Blade, Fixer suit, Yae key page
passive.fixercity.bayard: Offensive Position · Psych Up · Readied Position

kit.fixercity.bayard.desc: Workshop Halberd, Armored coat, Bayard key page
key_page.fixercity.hana_fixer.lore: [Hana Association] One for all, all for one.

kit.fixercity.hana_fixer.desc: Hana Association Sword, Fixer suit, Hana Association Fixer key page
passive.fixercity.mirinae.desc: Four Trigrams; the nearest ally gets the same trigram. Speed III
kit.fixercity.mirinae.desc: Hana Association Sword, Fixer suit, Mirinae key page
passive.fixercity.harold.desc: Four Trigrams. You endure the damage type that hit you hardest in the last 5s. Speed III
kit.fixercity.harold.desc: Hana Association Sword, Fixer suit, Harold key page
key_page.fixercity.olivier.lore: [Hana Association] One of the Twelve Fixers.
passive.fixercity.olivier: Four Trigrams · All for Hana · The Twelve Fixers
passive.fixercity.olivier.desc: Four Trigrams, All for Hana. +2 damage on every hit (+3 from emotion 3). Speed III
kit.fixercity.olivier.desc: Hana Association Sword, Armored coat, Olivier key page
